note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised (no surface here needs it). Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence against siblings 06-11: same product behavior, deliberately different composition.

entries.variance_notes: Two-column card directory on Home (icon, purpose, quiet counts fact line, subgroup footer) that hands off to flat destination rows inside a domain - a spatial directory, not an editorial list (06), a compendium index (07), broad hero cards (08), or tabs (09/11).
Exactly one scenario/fixture-gated banner; everything else lives in one compact bordered attention block with status-word column and one-line consequences, capped at four with an explicit expander.
Quiet top bar (named Back, breadcrumb, persistent compact search, identity, Close) over an in-stage settings rail that exists only below Home; narrow width drops the rail for pure push navigation.
Large hero field on Home, compact persistent field elsewhere; dropdown is anchored, opaque-layered, keyboard-driven; the query is a real history entry so Back restores query and results.
Twelve icon+label entries in a slim in-stage rail for cross-domain jumps at domain level; never primary chrome, never tabs, never pills.
Subgroups are separate destinations (dest/cat/sub) rather than scroll anchors; no spy is needed.

Dense single-line row (label + one-line description left, chips + live control right) with a note rail for states, a changed-from-default whisper, and a Details drawer for legacy scope/related/search terms; hairline break every 8 rows keeps groups digestible.
Chip vocabulary comes from the shell stylesheet by contract; Waypoint suppresses default/custom chips when the control itself already shows the value.
Row states explain themselves in a bordered note rail; unavailable search landings inject a 'Not available' reason note at the landing element so u: results never dead-end.

entries.concept_component: provider routing section via shared resolvers
entries.variance_notes: Requested-vs-effective strings render verbatim from PMProvider resolvers inside the Routing & fallback tab; no new inspector composition.

The Waypoint signature: integrated roster + detailed form workspace - sticky roster/section nav pane with an Actions strip, detail pane right; push panes at narrow. Not a preference book (06), not a faceted table (07), not tabbed sheets (11).
Grouped roster entries with status dots; object pages carry tab strips (data-tab) and per-tab sections rendered by one generic section grammar.
Tone dot + label + state word + note per check; read-only, no invented remedies.
Official source line, policy note, host/environment radio choice, numbered steps; the launcher is an explicit action that runs a staged op - never auto-acquisition.
One strip renders the latest op payload: name, status, phase, determinate bar only with a real denominator, terminal hold then clear. Shared op events are the only source.

entries.concept_component: copy receipt panel + toast on receipt events
entries.variance_notes: Receipts surface as quiet toasts; the copy transaction renders a full receipt panel with receipt id, restore point, applied/skipped counts, and a working rollback.
No secret material is ever rendered; copy preview shows '(reference)' values and the shared credential note verbatim.
The default provider view answers the human questions first (connected, account in use, included, on-exhaust, models, setup) as a key-value overview, with everything else as tabs.
Health-worded status chips, identity sublines, boundary note up top, priority/sticky in Details drawers.
In use / Shadowed / Manual only tags with shadow notes and refusal reasons inline; verify checklist and update history in the Details drawer.
Five-column table (model, context, modes, tools, route) capped with honest paging; capability words come from catalog evidence.
Evidence arrays render in the generic detail dump; no bespoke evidence composition.
Plans, included-remaining, projection, and the usage-unavailable reason render as plain overview fields from the shared snapshot.
Memory gists render through the shared roster grammar with detail drawers; no bespoke memory composition in this concept.
Persona roster + detail sections through the same grammar; behavior-not-authority prose comes from the def.
Crew templates are the second paged manager: roster left, per-crew pages with member tables right.
Rules render as ordered tables with managed pinning visible; rule mutation UX is not this concept's demonstration focus.
Event routing table plus destination roster through the section grammar.
Sound items with preview/upload/pack actions in the Actions strip as staged ops.
Appearance renders as preference rows; live theme switching belongs to the shell chrome, and fx.theme-fallback surfaces as a row error state.
m.commands shows the shortcuts table and conflicts health; recording/editing chords is deferred to the keyboard-first concept (c10) by design.
Same as CommandEditor.
Rosters, capability tables, and last-test previews through the generic grammar with per-item drawers.
Vault health checks plus what-uses-the-space and how-long-things-stay tables.
Artifact entries render through the shared roster grammar with dests.
